title: Chapter 428 Little Fish
content:
Chapter 428 Little Fish

Hearing the phantom in front of him, the vigilance in Haohan's ancestor's eyes disappeared and turned into a look of respect.

"So that's the case, so thank you."

The ancestor Haohan said in a polite voice and nodded.

The phantom nodded, said nothing, and disappeared directly.

Seeing the phantom leaving, the ancestor Haohan then let out a light breath. For some reason, he always felt an inexplicable sense of oppression when facing this strong man in Huangcheng who claimed to be the person in charge of the list.

Probably, this is the real strong man.

The ancestor Haohan sighed for a moment, then looked down at the token in his hand.

I saw that the token was small and exquisite, made of a special unknown material, which was cool to the touch and very comfortable.

And at this small token, a number - 1 appears.

The ancestor Haohan pinched the token and then injected a breath of his own.

The next moment, the token trembled slightly, emitting a green light.

Buzz —

A stream of space suction emerged, and the vast ancestor disappeared from the spot immediately.

When the ancestor Haohan opened his eyes again, he had already appeared in a place with rich energy, with starlight around him, as if he was in a sea of stars, which was so beautiful.

Feeling the comfort from his skin, the ancestor Haohan took a deep breath and exclaimed: "It's really a good place."

It is worthy of being a deserted city and a holy land.

Then, Haohan Ancestor hurriedly sat cross-legged on the ground and began to stabilize his realm.

Not long after, other strong men will inevitably challenge him. He is now at the top of the list. Only by consolidating his realm can he strive to maintain this position, even if the hope is extremely slim.

Being in this position has given the ancestor Haohan an unrealistic fantasy. If it is possible, he can really stay on the list for a week and become a veritable number one.

Although it was just a fantasy, it did give the vast ancestor strong motivation.

At this time, countless strong people in the deserted city developed extremely strong interest in this combat power list.

However, there are very few masters like the Great Ancestor and Chen Wei, who are in the Supreme Heaven, appear, and most of the challengers only challenge the top rankings of the combat power list.

In the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

A figure in a black robe was standing respectfully in front of Lu Xue, reporting on the news of the current combat power list.

After listening to the report of the black robe figure, Lu Xue looked complicated and murmured.

"Dad, you have really left a lot of backup."

This sudden list was not something that anyone else did, but Lu Daosheng.

Only Lu Daosheng can do such a shocking and terrifying operation.

Lu Xue was silent for a moment and asked, "Is there any news on the other list?"

There are two on the list, in addition to the combat power list, there is also the Tianjiao list!

However, since the list was launched, there has been no movement in the Tianjiao List. Many well-known Tianjiao rushed over after hearing the news, but they were in vain and complained. Seeing the battle power list shining brightly, they had to envy and hate.

Hearing Lu Xue’s question, the black robe figure shook his head, “Not yet.”

"I understand, step back and keep staring."

"yes."

The shadow faded away, and Lu Xue slowly closed her eyes. Now that the Chaos Realm has some time left, his father actually arranged a list in advance to inspire the sentient beings in the Chaos Realm to keep growing stronger.

Perhaps, Lu Daosheng also hopes that the Chaos Realm can rely on his own strength to protect the Chaos Realm.

"Um?!"

Suddenly, Lu Xue opened her eyes and looked up at the void.

Not only Lu Xue, but at this moment, the top strong men in the Chaos Realm all looked up at the void. They looked shocked, and even worse, they were already sweating profusely.

The huge black hole was still floating above the Chaos Realm, and a terrifying and uneasy aura kept coming.

But what makes the powerful men in the Chaos Realm like this is not the black hole, but the guardian light curtain left by Lu Daosheng.

At this moment, the guardian light curtain covering the entire Chaos Realm was gradually becoming dim.

Is the light curtain about to disappear?

Lu Daosheng no longer protects the Chaos Realm?

If this may be true, then the Chaos Realm is probably going to be over.

Some strong men are already sweating profusely.

In the lord's mansion of Huangcheng City, Mr. Jiang appeared beside Lu Xue.

Lu Xue's face was not very good at this time. If the guardian light curtain dissipated at this time, the Chaos Realm would lose the last barrier.

By then, the army of gods will attack, how can they resist their strength?

Looking at Lu Xue's sad face, Mr. Jiang comforted, "Miss, don't panic."

Hearing Mr. Jiang’s voice, Lu Xue looked at Mr. Jiang.

"Old Jiang, what do you think, what is my father thinking?"

Mr. Jiang shook his head slightly and said, "How can I guess the city lord's thoughts? But I believe that he will definitely not give up here."

"Why?"

Lu Xue was confused, Mr. Jiang was so confident.

Mr. Jiang stretched out his finger and pointed at him, "Because you, Miss, you are still here."

Hearing this, Lu Xue stood there in a daze.

Lu Daosheng's gentle face suddenly appeared in his mind. The scenes of the past were played back like movies. After a long time, Lu Xue suddenly smiled.

"Old Jiang, I understand."

Seeing that Lu Xue had regained her confidence, Mr. Jiang also smiled and continued, "Miss, you can't just look at the surface when looking at things."

Mr. Jiang looked up at the sky and said, "Miss, take a closer look."

"Um?"

Lu Xue looked up at the sky again, and her eyes looked through the sky at the flawless guardian light curtain. This time, she looked very seriously.

After a long time, she finally saw something.

"The light curtain left by my father is indeed getting weaker, but it seems that it is not as fast as it was at the beginning."

This seems to be telling something.

Lu Xue paced back and forth in the field, her mind running wildly.

Bang!

Lu Xue patted her palm and said excitedly: "I understand!"

"The guardian light curtain is not really weakening, but is creating gaps."

"It's like a fishing net. Now, it's increasing the density of the net, and the consequence is that it will allow some small fish to pass through the fishing net and enter the chaos world."

Old Jiang, who was standing by, nodded and echoed: "In that way, we can first practice the weaker existences in the land of the gods."

"The City Lord has really put a good intention."

At this moment, Lu Xue also lamented that her father was meticulous and could even think of this.

Dad, don't worry, I won't let you down.

At this time, the sentient beings in the Chaos Realm were already ready to fight the Gods Land, so the powerful people in the Gods Land that appeared in advance would not only not catch the Chaos Realm off guard, but would also arouse the fighting spirit of the powerful people in the Chaos Realm.

Lu Xue quickly told the Human Emperor Palace the information he had guessed.

When the Human Emperor Palace heard this news, it was also shocked.
